training_and_holdout_rules: Source-link owner revised preregistration: TRAIN W1D2 + E10D2 + whole CORE-SW; HOLD whole CORE-SE + distinct C-W2-D2 if its declared source reference is accepted. This packet records the grouping, not fit acceptance.
Each whole shaft/core family is one group. Do not count shaft corners, two shafts, or repeated levels of one body as independent validation.

W1D2/E10D2/W2D2 source families are supported by original row/bay topology. A source-link estimate must retain raster centre uncertainty and unquantified schematic/physical-reference bias. Native direct1F axis is not proved.
W1D4 row candidate, W3D3 split glyph, east circulation and rear stairs remain excluded until ambiguity resolves; W3D3 excluded from both training and validation.
Stair or escalator outer envelope corners, changing floor landings, and large front X voids are not paired shaft/column reference points.
Native front roof/canopy family A must not be automatically matched to interior rectangular glyphs; named native columns can slant/taper.
Local shape overlays or source-to-source residuals are not direct1F world registration accuracy.
limits: Original rasters are 960×572 and 631×496. Numeric readpoint intervals describe stroke/centre reading only, not feature width or structural identity uncertainty.
No exact metric footprint, floor height, common native world axis, 1F matrix, fit/composition, geometry installation or restored BP1F is claimed.

Paired-shaft envelope midpoints are declared source reference proxies, not exact physical shaft axes or whole core centres. Source-link use must explicitly retain their uncertainty and schematic-bias limits.
No complete vertical circulation inventory is claimed. Rear queries stopped after finite direct original review failed to establish a unique same-flight/landing endpoint.
Overlays independently scale and centre each local crop; they are shape-display diagnostics and not plan-wide registration or metric comparisons.
source_identity_meaning: SUPPORTED identifies the same source assembly family or grid ordinal by visible topology. It does not establish the same exact native body, an unchanged floor profile, a fixed XZ axis, or a world coordinate.

registration_routes.linked_source_estimate: Authorized as a separate estimate by root. Fresh same-feature source1F↔source2F correspondence may be composed with separately accepted official2F references. This packet provides source evidence only and performs no fit/composition. It does not copy 2F M to 1F or establish direct native1F registration.
registration_routes.direct_native_1F: Requires original native-body/actual1F profile qualification; none is established here.
registration_routes.both: Source identity ambiguity cannot be repaired by small residuals, old world projection, or reusing the same group for validation.

rear_flight_query.scope: Bounded requested rear 1F flights; original2F full image and rear platform context directly inspected. No world projection, outer cut corner, or native XZ used to pair points.
